notes: The C mount row is unrestricted at POS_STANDING; the focused registration test pins the authoritative gate (R1/R2/R5e).
The later ride row aliases the same do_ride call path and carries the same C gate (R1/R2/R5e).
The fighting early return preserves C's exact newline ordering (R1/R5e).
ROOM_INDOORS rejects riding before argument lookup with C's exact bytes (R1/R5e).
Bare mount reaches the exact prompt after one_argument (R1/R3/R5e).
C consumes the first target token and ignores trailing words; the live vehicle proves that boundary (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
An unresolved room target emits NOPERSON exactly (R1/R3/R5e).
Self-targeting reaches C's exact disgusting refusal (R1/R3/R5e).
A player target is not mountable and receives the canonical $N refusal (R1/R3/R5e).
IS_MOUNTED(ch) wins before mount lookup state changes (R1/R4/R5e).
A pre-ridden mount reaches the distinct C refusal after target resolution (R1/R3/R5e).
The focused test exercises IS_MOUNTABLE false and the exact $N refusal (R1/R5e).
CAN_MOUNT is true for every descriptor-issued player command after the preceding IS_MOUNTED gate; the !IS_MOB false branch is unreachable from this surface (R2/R4/R5e).
A charmed rider is denied after mountability and CAN_MOUNT gates (R1/R5e).
A mount charmed to another master is denied with the C $S expansion (R1/R5e).
Success sets both AFF_MOUNT bits, adds charm/follow state, and records the rider (R1/R4/R5e).
The actor and room peer receive the exact success bytes; the mob victim has no descriptor audience (R1/R3/R5e).
The ride alias reaches the same do_ride success path after dismounting (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
Lua mount(ride) is a non-command API call, not a registered descriptor command; its script caller plumbing is outside this command-family surface (R2/R4/R5e).
